title: Great design!
text: Great design!. I hesitated to try this design but am glad I did.  I've always had the ones that tie prior to now.  The fabric is a good weight--not flimsy but it isn't ultra heavy either.  I would caution that it seems to run small.  I went true to size, and it was tight across the bust even though I'm not a top heavy gal.
